BiblicalUsage: Daniel set Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego over the affairs of Babylon, the Chaldeans accused them of refusing the king's gods, and the three answered that they were not careful to answer the king in the matter. Meshach is the Babylonian name given to Mishael, and it stands in the story wherever the three stand together.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Meshach matters because of the company he kept: he would not bow with his friends, and the furnace could not separate what faith had joined.
RelatedEvents: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the Fiery Furnace
